title: PlaneMem current session source observation
description: Existing p02-session-current-v1 wire contract and complete decoded session projection. Standalone schema; root is the response envelope. Source-only TODO P0-01 increment.
$comment: JSON Schema does not enforce UTF-8 byte budgets, UTF-16 string lengths, decoded duplicate keys, exact Date roundtrip, field equality, digest computation, current authorization or deadlines. contentSchema is an annotation: consumers must decode and check session_json separately without reserializing it before hashing. No validator, generator or runtime verification performed.

text.$comment: Runtime bounds use UTF-16 code units. Whitespace-only nonempty text and escaped lone surrogates are not independently forbidden by this helper.

time.$comment: Runtime additionally requires finite Date.parse and exact toISOString roundtrip, including calendar validity. No generic permissive date-time substitution.

request.description: Raw body is strict UTF-8 flat string-valued JSON with case-insensitively unique decoded keys, including escaped names. Endpoint and configuration must exactly equal explicit Gateway configuration. Generate a new challenge per observation; Gateway does not check nonce uniqueness or entropy and never caches a same-key success.

target.description: Complete internal authority target and public result binding. Scope/actor/client come from authenticated context; challenge/request and trace/configuration remain exact across both grants.

authorization.description: Earliest token/grant/optional owning-source expiry, checked before return. Current reader does not clamp this timestamp to its own 30s elapsed budget. OPA adapter uses planemem-session-current:<64 lowercase hex>; the generic authority port permits other bounded refs. No bearer or grant target is serialized here.

grant.description: Internal authority port, not an HTTP response or client-supplied approval. Exact target; future expiry. Reader normalizes field order and compares both complete grants with JSON.stringify, including original expiry, preventing renewal.

source.description: Saved business reference, no duplicate/type allowlist/visibility/URI syntax check. Unknown members and null optional fields fail; array may be empty.

session.description: Decoded exact SQL business projection, not physical row bytes. Six owner/ID fields equal target. ended_at, if present, is >=started_at; failed/abandoned may omit it. Saved trace/sources remain historical and need not equal observation trace/sources. No parent-child inequality or graph read in direct store. SQL omits null parent/origin/ended only, refuses submillisecond timestamps. Origin bridge additionally requires its original lineage and no resume_origin.

observed_at.description: Owning SELECT statement timestamp, not HTTP send time, last mutation time or returned-state lease.

session_json.description: Exact owning-source projection text, preserving whitespace/key order. UTF-8<=65536, not the size of its escaped outer JSON representation. No contentEncoding/base64. Parse/validate separately; contentSchema alone does not assert its content.

session_digest.description: SHA-256 of exact session_json UTF-8 bytes; do not canonicalize or reserialize first. Not an authenticity signature.

result.description: Public current-only observation. No original proof/selection, stops, runs, tools, checkpoints, authorization bearer or source_revalidate callback. Not an original creation receipt, execution permission or guarantee that row remains unchanged after observation.

envelope.description: Current request trace equals data.trace_id; sole source id equals data.session_id, unlike original start's client_id reference. No ETag/revision/cursor and no dedicated serialized full-envelope byte cap.
